g.text: K1: the tactile sensor is the compression capacitor
Proposed nail stack · schematic, not to scale · no force calibration or physical result
Silicone posts: 0.15 mm high, 0.60 mm diameter
0.05 mm base · vented spaces between posts
CIN sensing electrode, covered by polyimide coverlay
Two copper layers + core + coverlays: 0.136 mm target
Driven SHLD1 plane behind the sensing electrode
0.05 mm nail mounting layer, then the existing hard nail
TPU cells use the separate conforming rigid saddle
Four cell wires: CIN · driven shield · upper-plate ground drive · separate upper-plate ground return
Two boards: A = CH0/CH2/CH3, B = CH1/CH4/CH5. Each has a protected, unloaded CIN4 reference.
Electrode fabrication, plate contacts, stops/retention, vents, cable routing and physical validation remain.
